snippet.title: PES 2010 (PC) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Pro Evolution Soccer 2010 (officially abbreviated as PES 2010 and known in Asia as World Soccer: Winning Eleven 2010) is the ninth football video game in the Pro Evolution Soccer series. The game was developed and published by Konami.

▌PC Gameplays Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLXEHhSievieFw3PRaPmrVQ4mTjr4BMRE0
